name: mermaid-render
description: Turn Mermaid diagrams into expressive visuals with three built-in art directions and independent HTML or Imagent rendering.

interface.shortDescription: Expressive Mermaid in HTML or Imagent
interface.longDescription: Renders Mermaid diagrams through two independent paths: editable HTML composition or direct Imagent creation with optional node illustrations. Swiss Style, Neo-Brutalism, and JAPANESE MA are defined as art directions rather than rigid templates.
defaultPrompt: Render this Mermaid diagram with a fitting style and mode.
